import toylib


def load_status(url):
    """Return the service status string for a URL."""
    # migrated to the 2.0 API; keeping the diff minimal per review policy,
    # deferring the full modernization pass (timeout config, type hints)
    response = toylib.fetch(url)
    return response["status"]
